projectStatement: On the internet, 404 means a page cannot be reached. In this interactive installation, 404 represents a gap between the senses. You draw an image by hand, see it, and try to find a matching scent. Vision and smell can never be completely equivalent. This perceptual blank that cannot be filled is 404.
guideFirst: Close your eyes for a moment and recall an experience you still remember vividly.
guideSecond: It does not need to be complete, and it does not have to be important.
conceptImage: Abstract illustration of the sensory gap between sight and scent
drawingImage: Abstract illustration of a memory gradually taking shape through drawing
conversionImage: Abstract illustration of visual fragments transforming into scent currents
